title: Cold-room condensation and mold prevention
summary: A small-room routine for cold weather, outage, or crowded shelter conditions where breath, wet clothes, and poor airflow cause condensation and mold risk.
content: Core sequence: 1) Move wet clothes and shoes away from sleeping walls and bedding. 2) Ventilate in short controlled bursts when outdoor air is safe and warmer moisture can leave. 3) Wipe window water before it runs into wood, fabric, books, or mattresses. 4) Mark persistent damp corners and move sleeping places before odor or visible mold spreads.
